activity.notes: Later Icelandic saga traditions associate Erik the Red with organizing the Norse settlement of Greenland around 985 CE. ATLAS follows the same conservative pattern used for Leif Erikson: it records only the approximate colonization episode under Norse Greenland, marks confidence likely, and does not invent a continuous chieftainship or treat saga detail as exact chronology.

sources.title: Leif Erikson — World History Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The overview situates Erik the Red's establishment of the Greenland settlement around 985 CE and describes the saga-based family tradition surrounding the Greenland Norse colony.
